start: A workout open, no rest running

steps.action: Look at the watch between sets

Last time's numbers in grey, e.g. '60 kg × 8'
Today's target in the accent colour when it differs

steps.action: Log the set on the phone

start: The next set is a warm-up

start: First time doing this exercise (no last time), or a phone app older than the next-set lines

steps.action: Look at the watch between sets
user_sees: No last-time line; only what is known, or the phone's one text line

start: Today's target is the same as last time's numbers

user_sees: One line with the numbers, not two equal lines

steps.action: Finish the last set of the exercise

start: Member who did this exercise last week in another routine

steps.action: Look at the watch between sets
